Per enrichment rules, central Erasmus Mundus schemes carry no attached supervising professor - applicants are admitted to the consortium curriculum rather than to a specific supervisor - so outcome is not_applicable with no professors.

France-South Africa Scholarship Programme 2027 is a government-to-government bilateral scheme (France Excellence) administered by the Embassy of France in South Africa; the programme site is southafrica-france-scholarships.com. Laureates may attend any French higher education institution and the scheme publishes no supervising professors or faculty, so no supervisor research is applicable.

The Mastercard Foundation Scholars Program at Sciences Po is an admissions-based, fully funded graduate scholarship supporting two-year Master's study at Sciences Po (fee waiver via International Graduate Admissions Procedure, selection by the Programme's Selection Committee). It is a taught-degree scholarship with no research supervision: the official programme page (sciencespo.fr/students/en/fees-funding/bursaries-financial-aid/mastercard-foundation-scholarships/graduate-study) names no supervising professors or research faculty, and no faculty tie to the scholarship was found on official Sciences Po pages.

Hungarian bilateral state scholarships are government-to-government scholarships administered by Tempus Public Foundation (en.tka.hu), Hungary's national scholarship office, under cooperation agreements with partner countries. Recipients are nominated or individually apply for study/research visits at Hungarian institutions chosen later in the process; the scheme itself attaches no named supervising professors, so no supervisor research is applicable.

The Semmelweis Pannonia In Excellence Scholarship is a university merit-based stipend for foreign nationals already enrolled as students at Semmelweis University (Faculties of Medicine, Dentistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Health Sciences and the Andras Peto Faculty), awarded for outstanding academic progress and sports/arts achievements (HUF 900,000-2,900,000/year, 12 monthly instalments). The official Registrar's Office page documents evaluation by a committee composed of the Vice-Rector for International Studies, the Faculty Deans and student representatives - no research supervision or supervising professors are attached to this funding; contact pannonia.in@semmelweis.hu.
